facts.text: Snow left State Lakes (10,400 ft) 30 days earlier this year than the midpoint of two of the three earlier seasons on file (2024 and 2025).

evidence.name: State Lakes
evidence.detail: left May 1; earlier seasons: May 31 (2024), May 30 (2025); 2023: readings jump by more than snow can

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the second highest of three of the four seasons on file (2024 to 2026) at Blackcap Basin (10,180 ft) and the lowest at State Lakes (10,400 ft).

evidence.name: State Lakes
evidence.detail: 4.7 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 25.7 in (2024), 23.3 in (2025)

evidence.name: Blackcap Basin
evidence.detail: 20.6 in on May 1; earlier seasons: 43.5 in (2024), 5.8 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 25 and June 10, carried from the melt-out dates at State Lakes (10,400 ft) and Blackcap Basin (10,180 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: State Lakes
evidence.detail: melted out May 1, at the pass elevation; points to April 10 to May 23

evidence.name: Blackcap Basin
evidence.detail: melted out May 30, 260 ft below the pass; points to May 11 to June 27
